T: Taste. Don't eat. Then order the cheeseburger.
D: A couple join a handful of rich guests at an exclusive island restaurant where the tasting menu turns sinister.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Margot asks the chef for one.
S: Cultured butter, whipped ricotta and olive oil with warm sourdough, bread included
A bowl of cultured butter, olive oil, whipped ricotta and a few flakes of salt. Then, because you're not on that island, a warm sourdough loaf to go with them.
Thinly sliced raw scallops with lime, finger lime pearls, olive oil and sea salt
Scallops sliced thin and dressed with lime, finger lime, a few drops of good olive oil and sea salt, set on a cold stone or a chilled plate.
the tortillas with the guests' secrets printed on them

Warm corn tortillas charred on a dry pan, with a smoky charred tomato and chipotle salsa, smashed avocado with lime and crumbled feta. Char 4 tomatoes, half a white onion and 2 garlic cloves in a dry pan until blackened in spots. Blitz with 1 chipotle in adobo, a handful of coriander, lime juice and salt. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Warm 16 small corn tortillas in a hot dry pan for 30 seconds a side until lightly charred and keep wrapped in a tea towel. Serve with the salsa, avocado and 80g crumbled feta.
M: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion and pickles, crinkle cut fries
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, two patties, American cheese, white onion and pickles on a soft toasted bun, crinkle-cut fries. Pack one to go.
Hawthorn lamb rack with celeriac purée
a tasting menu main, without the theatre

Lamb rack roasted pink and carved into cutlets, on silky celeriac purée with charred baby leeks and a glossy red wine jus. Simmer a peeled, diced celeriac in 400ml milk for 20 minutes, then blitz with 40g butter until silky. Season 2 lamb racks, sear fat side down, then roast at 200C to 56C inside, about 15 minutes, and rest 10 minutes. Blanch 8 baby leeks for 2 minutes and char in a hot pan. Reduce 200ml red wine with a shallot by half, add 300ml beef stock and reduce until glossy, then whisk in 20g butter.
W: Chocolate ganache in a cookie crust, topped with torched meringue
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache set inside, topped with a toasted marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: Gin, bitter aperitivo and sweet vermouth with a smoking rosemary sprig

Gin, bitter red aperitivo and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, poured over a big cube and finished with a smouldering rosemary sprig and orange. For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitivo and 30ml sweet vermouth with ice for 20 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler. Light the tip of a rosemary sprig until it smokes, blow it out and lay it across the glass with a twist of orange peel.

s.note: Cultured butter, whipped ricotta and olive oil with warm sourdough, bread included
s.how: Set out a bowl of 125g cultured butter, a dish of olive oil and 150g whipped ricotta, each with a few salt flakes. Then, because you're not on that island, warm a sourdough loaf and serve it with them.

s.note: Thinly sliced raw scallops with lime, finger lime pearls, olive oil and sea salt
s.how: Slice 300g very fresh scallops thin and lay on chilled plates. Dress with the juice of a lime, the pearls of 2 finger limes, a few drops of olive oil and sea salt. Serve straight away.

m.note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion and pickles, crinkle cut fries
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with white onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes crinkle-cut, twice. Wrap one to take home.

w.note: Chocolate ganache in a cookie crust, topped with torched meringue
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a tart tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, spread on top and torch until blistered.

d.note: Gin, bitter aperitivo and sweet vermouth with a smoking rosemary sprig
d.how: For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitivo and 30ml sweet vermouth with ice for 20 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler. Light the tip of a rosemary sprig until it smokes, blow it out and lay it across the glass with a twist of orange peel.
